detail.description:
Location

A great place to have a rest after an exciting day! Hotel «Shyanu Lords Eco Inn Airoli-Near Mindspace» is located in Navi Mumbai. This hotel is located in 16 km from the city center. You can take a walk and explore the neighbourhood area of the hotel. Places nearby: Powai Lake, Juhu Beach and Versova Beach.

At the hotel

It’s time to have a nice meal! Stop by the restaurant. Free Wi-Fi is available on the territory. Ask for more information when checking in. Specially for tourists who travel by car, there’s a parking zone. For the free movement around the city, the hotel offers a transfer for you.

There are other services available for the guests of the hotel. For example, a laundry, dry cleaning and ironing.
